description.en: The name of the account to be created.

description.zh: 待创建账号的账号密码。
description.en: The password of the account to be created.

description.zh:
给新创建的账号授权某数据库的权限，包括：

- ReadWrite
- ReadOnly
- DMLOnly
- DDLOnly
description.en:
The permissions to be granted to the new account on the specified database. Valid values:

- ReadWrite
- ReadOnly
- DMLOnly
- DDLOnly.
The name of the database to be authorized.
The region in which the instance resides.

description.zh:
安全管理员账号名称。

> 若已开启三权分立模式，该参数必填，未开启三权分立可以不填。
description.en:
The name of the security administrator account.

> If three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. If three-role mode is not enabled, this parameter is not required.

description.zh:
安全管理员账号密码。

> 若已开启三权分立模式，该参数必填，未开启三权分立可以不填。
description.en:
The password of the security administrator account.

> If three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. If three-role mode is not enabled, this parameter is not required.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx create-account --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-00000000000000 --account-name testAccount --account-password Test@1111 --db-name testdb --account-privilege ReadWrite --account-description test --security-account-name securityAccount --security-account-password securityPassword --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardbx CreateAccount --region cn-hangzhou --AccountDescription test --SecurityAccountPassword securityPassword --AccountPrivilege ReadWrite --DBName testdb --SecurityAccountName securityAccount --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBInstanceName 'pxc-00000000000000' --AccountName testAccount --AccountPassword 'Test@1111'
